import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 10;
    static final int M = 1000007;
    static final int K = 200;
    static final int p = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static int[] e = new int[N];
    static int[] s = new int[M];
    static int[] wf = new int[K];
    static int[][] q = new int[N][K];
    static int[][] f = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] ans = new int[N][M];
    static BitSet[] op = new BitSet[40];
    static BitSet[][] wq = new BitSet[N][M];
    static Map<BitSet, Integer>[] rt = new HashMap[N];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
            op[i] = new BitSet(40);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            wq[i] = new BitSet[M];
            for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                wq[i][j] = new BitSet(40);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            rt[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
    }

    static int read_value(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        int val = 0;
        int c;
        while (true) {
            c = br.read();
            if (c == -1) break;
            if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') break;
        }
        do {
            val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = br.read();
        } while (c >= '0' && c <= '9');
        return val;
    }

    static long mod_pow(long base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % p;
            base = (base * base) % p;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void process_node(int u, BufferedReader br) {
        q[u][0] = 0;
        int total_os = 0, total_of = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            if (s[i] == u) {
                q[u][++q[u][0]] = i;
                wf[i] = ++total_os;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= e[u - 1]; i++) {
            if (ans[u - 1][i] == 0) continue;
            for (int h = 1; h < (1 << n); h++) {
                long probability = 1;
                for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    if (((h >> c) & 1) == 1) {
                        probability = (probability * f[u][c + 1]) % p;
                    } else {
                        probability = (probability * ((p - f[u][c + 1]) % p + p) % p) % p;
                    }
                }
                BitSet c = (BitSet) wq[u - 1][i].clone();
                BitSet hc = new BitSet(40);
                boolean changed = false;
                for (int x = 1; x <= q[u - 1][0]; x++) {
                    if (c.get(x - 1)) {
                        int qx = q[u - 1][x];
                        if ((qx & (1 << (c.nextSetBit(0)))) != 0) {
                            for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {
                                if (((1 << t) & h) != 0 && ((qx & (1 << t)) )==0) {
                                    hc.set(wf[qx | (1 << t)]);
                                    changed = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!changed) continue;
                int pos;
                if (!rt[u].containsKey(hc)) {
                    rt[u].put(hc, ++total_of);
                    e[u]++;
                    wq[u][e[u]] = (BitSet) hc.clone();
                }
                pos = rt[u].get(hc);
                ans[u][pos] = (int)((ans[u][pos] + probability * ans[u - 1][i]) % p);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = read_value(br);
        for (int i = 0; i <= (1 << n); i++) {
            s[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                int val = read_value(br);
                f[i][j] = (int)((val * mod_pow(100, p - 2)) % p);
            }
        }
        q[0][0] = 1;
        e[0] = 1;
        ans[0][1] = 1;
        wq[0][1].set(0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            process_node(i, br);
        }
        System.out.println(ans[n][1]);
    }
}
